objects.description: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) has used the Exchange Power Shell module Set-OabVirtualDirectoryPowerShell to export mailbox data.(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)(Citation: Volexity Exchange Marauder March 2021)
objects.description_fa: [HAFNIUM](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0125) از ماژول Exchange Power Shell Set-OabVirtualDirectoryPowerShell برای صادر کردن داده‌های صندوق پست استفاده کرده است.(Citation: Microsoft HAFNIUM March 2020)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_2]] (Citation: Volexity Exchange Marauder March 2021)
